map.Navy 法只需围度（男腰+颈，女腰+臀+颈），皮褶法需卡尺多点；均属估算（误差: The Navy method only needs circumferences (male waist+neck, female waist+hip+neck), while skinfold needs multi-point calipers; both are estimates (error +/-3-4%); the Navy method is more sensitive to waist-hip ratio and measurement caliber, suitable for self-testing without calipers.
map.女性为什么必须量臀围？: Why must women measure hip circumference?
